summary: Busy Moggill Road arterial kerb with no parking lane and tight verge.
reasons: Steep and boxed in by bank

drivers.seclusion: Medical practice 12 m away, retail and apartments within 25-45 m; exposed on an arterial.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerbside lane carries road arrows and feeds traffic; verge beyond is a planted bank, no room to pull out of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Multi-lane arterial with tram-style poles, heavy traffic and noise.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along the stretch except one at the east end; no marked parking lane.

sun_shade: Open to the north sun; trees shade the south side at the west end.
